Dee Dee's family confronted her about her abuse of treatment of Gypsy and raised suspicion about her role in her stepmother's decline of health. Gypsy says Dee Dee also kept her leashed and handcuffed to her bed for two weeks after this event. Based on that information, police asked Facebook to trace the IP address from which the posts to Dee Dee's account had been made. The IP address was located in Wisconsin. On June 15, police found Gypsy in Wisconsin with her boyfriend Nicholas Go to Jean.
